## AC5 evidence: rotation is tracked explicitly and is now DONE

AC5 required that the currently-logged token be rotated and that the rotation be RECORDED,
not assumed. Recording it here.

- The operator running this session attested on 2026-08-04 that all affected credentials in
  this incident have been rotated and all leaked material purged.
- The rotation ticket of record is 43ea-3d5a-078f-4fe3 ("Rotate compromised
  GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN"), which carries the deploy / rotate / verify steps and now holds the
  same attestation. That is the "tracked separately and explicitly" half of AC5.

AC1-AC4 are satisfied by the landed change, commit 4e8c83c833, Gerrit change 1384, MERGED
with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1:
- AC1: the secret no longer appears in any emitted log record -- credential moved from the
  query string to the X-Rebar-Token header (src/rebar/review_bot/app.py) plus
  TokenRedactingFilter / install_access_log_redaction (src/rebar/review_bot/config.py);
  proven by sentinel-based tests in tests/unit/test_review_bot_token_redaction.py.
- AC2: the mechanism is stated in the code where the choice is made (header vs redaction
  filter), in those same two modules.
- AC3: infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md no longer instructs the operator to put the
  credential in the URL; the /rerun recipe was rewritten and the rotation note added.
- AC4: the access log still records route and status for both endpoints -- the redaction
  filter scrubs only the credential, so the observability greps still work.

Also note f7f0-8b56-8b6d-4d54 was closed as a duplicate of this ticket for its code half.
